selected_scenes.scene: Quiet home hallway opening into a bedroom/living-room corner. Aachu sits in the lower right in soft three-quarter profile, withdrawn but not theatrically sad, with her face unobscured. Zuv is close enough for a readable medium shot in the lower left/mid doorway, upright on socks with one foot only slightly lifted. One hand lightly holds the half-open door edge/handle so it will not swing or creak; the other carries a cup with the teaspoon pinned still against the rim so it will not clink. The curtain and angled chair stay secondary.
selected_scenes.text_placement: Upper-middle negative space, warm charcoal handwritten text baked into the paper.
selected_scenes.identity_plan: Use loaded raw Aachu and Zuv face anchors; Aachu face slightly larger and clear, Zuv no farther than readable medium shot, no hidden profile, no tiny doorway face.
selected_scenes.style_plan: Premium A Story watercolor-and-ink, neutral off-white paper, no yellow/parchment, tiny top-right brandmark.
